text:
Incident Bot: :rotating_light: PAGER: SEV2 - private-connectivity - multiple customers reporting intermittent connectivity to services in us-east-1a via PrivateLink (possible AS path split). PagerDuty: paging @Ash SRE (primary oncall) and @Raj Patel (netops).

Ash SRE: seeing alerts from our health checks and customer telemetry. TCP syns timing out to private endpoint in us-east-1a, but us-east-1b path looks good.

Raj Patel: confirming BGP updates from cloud provider show duplicate AS_PATH announcements for our private link prefixes — looks like one of their edges is leaking an alternate path with lower MED.

Maria Gomez: tagging in infra. Are there any recent changes to route policies or peering that could explain this?

Ash SRE: no config pushes from our side in the last 24h. diffs show no ACL/route-policy changes.

DevOps Bot: deploy event 1752001400: no related network changes.

James Lee (CSM): customer ACME-Corp reports increased 5xx and timeouts in logs since ~08:07 UTC. Major impact to API traffic that traverses PrivateLink to our inference pool. They're on a dedicated connection.

Raj Patel: running quick BGP digests now. `show ip bgp neighbors` -> seeing two active neighbors advertising overlapping prefixes; one via edge-a (us-east-1a) with AS_PATH `65001 65010`, one via edge-b (us-east-1b) with AS_PATH `65001 65020` but lower MED. Cloud provider may have started preferring 1b. That explains traffic shift and some asymmetric paths causing session drops.

Ash SRE: initial mitigation: temporarily increase local-pref on routes learned via us-east-1a to prefer that path for affected customers. Doing this as a short-term fix to stabilize sessions while provider engages. Executing `route-map PREFER_USA1 permit 10` and `set local-preference 200` now.

Raj Patel: hold pattern — I see the local-pref change applied, BGP tables updated. Routes now prefer us-east-1a. Monitoring for session recovery.

James Lee (CSM): informing ACME-Corp that we applied a mitigation and we expect recovery in ~2-3 minutes. They responded: "thanks, we see improvement on a few calls but some retries still failing."

Incident Bot: :clipboard: Incident created: INC-20260315-32. Severity SEV2 (partial outage for PrivateLink customers).

Maria Gomez: can we confirm if this affects Dedicated customers with pinned endpoints or only cross-AZ PrivateLink?

Ash SRE: initial triage: only PrivateLink endpoints that rely on cross-AZ routing (those with dual-edge advertising) are impacted. Dedicated reserved pools pinned to a single endpoint remain reachable.

Raj Patel: opened case with cloud provider support (case #CLOUD-88764) and provided BGP dumps and timestamps. They acknowledged and say network engineering is investigating possible misconfigured MED propagation on their side.

Ash SRE: rolling back local-pref change in 20m unless we see reversion or sustained instability. Need to avoid long-term drift from provider.

DevOps Bot: scheduled a config audit against route policies to record temporary changes. Audit ticket: CFG-4821.

James Lee (CSM): coordinating a customer-facing update. Proposed message: "We experienced instability on PrivateLink paths between AZs resulting in intermittent timeouts; we've applied a temporary routing preference to stabilize connectivity and are working with the cloud provider on a permanent fix." Any objections?

Maria Gomez: looks good. Add expected ETA for next update (30 min).

Ash SRE: quick monitoring note: error rate for ACME-Corp dropped from 12% -> 2% after change. Latency 95th P99 improved but still slightly elevated.

Raj Patel: provider reports they've detected a BGP attribute regression on edge-a peer and are preparing to re-advertise with corrected MED in ~15-25 minutes. They asked us to keep our temporary local-pref to avoid flapping.

Ash SRE: leaving local-pref in place. I'll hand off to night oncall in 25m.

Incident Bot: :bell: On-call handoff scheduled at 1752005256 to Ash (night). PagerDuty: sending handoff notification.

Ash SRE: brief handoff notes for next oncall: 1) Root cause suspected: provider-side MED/AS path preference change causing asymmetric routing and session timeouts. 2) Temporary mitigation: increased local-pref for affected prefixes to keep traffic on us-east-1a. 3) Customer impact: partial degradation for PrivateLink customers relying on cross-AZ routes (ACME-Corp among them). 4) Provider case #CLOUD-88764. 5) Rollback plan: remove local-pref after provider confirms corrected advertisement and we observe stability for 15min. 6) Postmortem owner: Raj Patel.

Raj Patel: will take postmortem write-up. Will include BGP dumps, timeline, and recommended permanent change: prefer provider fix but add guardrails in our routing policy to avoid short-lived MED-induced flips (e.g., require hold-time > 90s before switching local-pref).

James Lee (CSM): logged customer update. ACME-Corp acknowledged and asked for RCA when available.

Maria Gomez: reminder to create follow-up ticket to evaluate adding synthetic tests for private connectivity across AZs. Ticket: OBS-1293.

Ash SRE: closing timeline for now — will monitor for next 45m then escalate if provider doesn't confirm.

DevOps Bot: recorded state change: mitigation-applied -> monitoring. Config snapshot saved at 1752003620.

Incident Bot: summary: SEV2 private-connectivity incident affecting PrivateLink cross-AZ paths in us-east-1. Temporary local-pref applied to prefer us-east-1a; provider engaged; customers showing reduced error rates. Next update scheduled in 30m or on provider confirmation.

Raj Patel: follow-up note at 1752005200: provider confirmed corrected MED advertisement, we can start a staged rollback in 5m and observe.

Ash SRE: starting staged rollback -> removing `set local-preference 200` from route-map for impacted prefixes. Pausing to watch BGP convergence.

Raj Patel: BGP convergence complete. Routes now converge to provider preference (us-east-1b) but no customer-facing errors detected in the 10m observation window.

James Lee (CSM): reached out to ACME-Corp - they confirm normal traffic and reduced latency. They requested a short RCA when ready.

Ash SRE: marking incident as mitigated at 1752005256. Will leave postmortem and follow-ups for Raj.

Maria Gomez: thanks everyone. Postmortem and improvement tickets expected within 48h. :thumbsup:

Incident Bot: incident INC-20260315-32 -> state: mitigated.

(End of thread)
